t: Which family does the ovarian tumor belong to?
key: Name the normal cell the tumor imitates: surface epithelium gives serous, mucinous, endometrioid and Brenner tumors; germ cells give teratomas and marker-secreting tumors; sex cord-stromal cells make hormones; bilateral signet-ring or mucinous masses point to a gut primary.
items: Psammoma bodies in a bilateral serous tumor
epi
Serous tumors come from Müllerian-type surface epithelium, and their carcinomas lay down concentric calcified psammoma bodies.
Transitional-type nests with coffee-bean nuclei
epi
The Brenner tumor is an epithelial tumor of urothelium-like cells and is usually benign.
Carcinoma arising in an endometriotic cyst
epi
Clear cell and endometrioid carcinomas grow from endometriosis, which is displaced Müllerian epithelium.
Precursor lesion in the fimbriated tube
epi
Serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma is the epithelial precursor of high-grade serous carcinoma.
Schiller-Duval bodies with a high AFP
germ
The yolk sac tumor imitates embryonic yolk sac, which makes alpha-fetoprotein.
Clear fried-egg cells with a high LDH
germ
Dysgerminoma is the ovarian counterpart of seminoma and is made of primitive germ cells.
Hair, teeth and sebum in a cyst
germ
The mature cystic teratoma holds tissues from all three germ layers, so it comes from a germ cell.
Thyroid tissue causing hyperthyroidism
germ
Struma ovarii is a monodermal teratoma made mostly of thyroid follicles, so it is a germ cell tumor.
Call-Exner bodies with a high inhibin
scs
Granulosa cell tumors copy follicle granulosa cells, which normally make estrogen and inhibin.
Virilization from a solid ovarian mass
scs
Sertoli-Leydig cell tumors copy testicular-type stromal cells and secrete androgens.
Ascites and right pleural effusion that resolve after surgery
scs
The fibroma of Meigs syndrome is a stromal tumor of collagen-producing fibroblasts.
Precocious puberty from an ovarian mass in a girl
scs
A juvenile granulosa cell tumor secretes estrogen, which drives breast development and bleeding.
Signet-ring cells in both ovaries
met
Mucin-filled signet-ring cells in both ovaries define a Krukenberg tumor, a metastasis.
Diffuse gastric adenocarcinoma found on endoscopy
met
The stomach is the usual source of Krukenberg tumors, which spread to the ovaries.
Pseudomyxoma peritonei with an appendiceal tumor
met
Gelatinous peritoneal mucin usually comes from an appendiceal mucinous tumor that has seeded the ovaries.
